  case "vy": return require("@shikijs/langs/vyper").default;
  case "wasm": return require("@shikijs/langs/wasm").default;
  case "wenyan": return require("@shikijs/langs/wenyan").default;
  case "文言": return require("@shikijs/langs/wenyan").default;
  case "wgsl": return require("@shikijs/langs/wgsl").default;
  case "wikitext": return require("@shikijs/langs/wikitext").default;
  case "mediawiki": return require("@shikijs/langs/wikitext").default;
  case "wiki": return require("@shikijs/langs/wikitext").default;
  case "wit": return require("@shikijs/langs/wit").default;
  case "wolfram": return require("@shikijs/langs/wolfram").default;
  case "wl": return require("@shikijs/langs/wolfram").default;
  case "xml": return require("@shikijs/langs/xml").default;
  case "xsl": return require("@shikijs/langs/xsl").default;
  case "yaml": return require("@shikijs/langs/yaml").default;
  case "yml": return require("@shikijs/langs/yaml").default;
  case "zenscript": return require("@shikijs/langs/zenscript").default;
  case "zig": return require("@shikijs/langs/zig").default;
  default: return null;
  }
}
const loadedName = new Map();
const pending = new Map();

/** True when Shiki bundles a grammar under this id or alias (lower-case). */
export function shikiHasLanguage(id) { return Boolean(id) && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(bundledLanguages, id); }
export function shikiLanguageCount() { return Object.keys(bundledLanguages).length; }
export function shikiIsLoaded(id) { return loadedName.has(id); }
/** Loads a grammar (and the grammars it embeds) synchronously; false when Shiki has none. */
export function shikiLoadLanguageSync(id) {
  if (loadedName.has(id)) return true;
  const grammars = grammarSync(id);
  if (!grammars) return false;
  highlighter.loadLanguageSync(grammars);
  loadedName.set(id, grammars[grammars.length - 1].name);
  return true;
}
export function shikiLoadLanguage(id) { return Promise.resolve(shikiLoadLanguageSync(id)); }
/** Lines of [text, lightColor, darkColor, fontStyle] tuples, or null when the grammar is not loaded. */
export function shikiTokens(code, id) {
  const lang = loadedName.get(id);
  if (!lang) return null;
  const result = highlighter.codeToTokens(code, { lang, themes: { light: "pierre-light", dark: "pierre-dark" }, defaultColor: false });
  return result.tokens.map((line) => line.map((t) => [t.content, t.htmlStyle?.["--shiki-light"] ?? null, t.htmlStyle?.["--shiki-dark"] ?? null, t.fontStyle ?? 0]));
}

// Tokenizes `code` continuing from `state` (a previous call's grammarState), so a long block can be tokenized a few
// lines per JS turn. Returns the lines and the state after the last line.
export function shikiTokensFromState(code, id, state) {
  const lang = loadedName.get(id);
  if (!lang) return null;
  const result = highlighter.codeToTokens(code, { lang, themes: { light: "pierre-light", dark: "pierre-dark" }, defaultColor: false, grammarState: state ?? undefined });
  return { lines: result.tokens.map((line) => line.map((t) => [t.content, t.htmlStyle?.["--shiki-light"] ?? null, t.htmlStyle?.["--shiki-dark"] ?? null, t.fontStyle ?? 0])), state: result.grammarState ?? null };
}
